atmospheres.name: Calm density
atmospheres.fit: Info-rich tools with quiet chrome (Linear / Stripe / Vercel class).

atmospheres.name: Swiss / International
atmospheres.fit: Grid-led, typographic clarity, strong hierarchy, little ornament.

atmospheres.name: Strategic minimalism
atmospheres.fit: One clear action per view; ruthless reduction without burying data.

atmospheres.name: Liquid glass
atmospheres.fit: Refractive, reactive translucency (Apple-native feel; use sparingly on web).

atmospheres.name: Glassmorphism
atmospheres.fit: Frosted blur panels over rich bg; chrome/modals, not dense tables.

atmospheres.name: Soft UI (neumorphism)
atmospheres.fit: Extruded soft shadows; consumer/low-density only—watch contrast.

atmospheres.name: Claymorphism
atmospheres.fit: Soft, saturated, floating clay shapes; friendly consumer SaaS.

atmospheres.name: Neo-brutalism
atmospheres.fit: Hard borders, high contrast, raw/bold marketing-adjacent product.

atmospheres.name: Flat
atmospheres.fit: No fake depth; solid fills, simple borders; classic efficient UI.

atmospheres.name: Material tonal
atmospheres.fit: Tonal surfaces and seed-color harmony (Material You climate).

atmospheres.name: Editorial
atmospheres.fit: Magazine type, display serif moments, strong typographic rhythm.

atmospheres.name: Dark tooling
atmospheres.fit: Dark-first, monospace accents, high-contrast developer/ops tools.

atmospheres.name: Bento modular
atmospheres.fit: Asymmetric modular cards; feature hubs and light dashboards.

atmospheres.name: Soft pastel
atmospheres.fit: Airy pastels, generous radius, gentle gradients; consumer onboarding.

atmospheres.name: Spatial depth
atmospheres.fit: Subtle layered shadows/3D accents for hierarchy without skeuomorphism.
